How many postings landed in the last 7 days, by source?
sql: SELECT silver_roles.source, COUNT(*) AS postings FROM scout.core.silver_roles WHERE silver_roles.created_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS GROUP BY silver_roles.source ORDER BY postings DESC

question: Of the tasks with a measured exposure score, how many are human-led, AI-assisted and automatable?
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN task_exposure.automation_share <= 0.33 THEN 'Human-led' WHEN task_exposure.automation_share >= 0.66 THEN 'Automatable' ELSE 'AI-assisted' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS tasks FROM scout.core.task_exposure GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY tasks DESC

question: Which companies have the most open postings?
sql: SELECT silver_companies.name, COUNT(*) AS open_postings FROM scout.core.silver_roles JOIN scout.core.silver_companies ON silver_roles.company_id = silver_companies.id WHERE silver_roles.lifecycle = 'open' GROUP BY silver_companies.name ORDER BY open_postings DESC LIMIT 20

content: silver_roles is the hourly Delta mirror of the app's live job postings (one row per posting). A posting is open when lifecycle = 'open'. 'Landed', 'dropped' or 'new' means created_at (the timestamp the app first saw it); 'this week' means created_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS. role_type is the function (SWE, AI, Data, Product, Sales, Finance, Operations, Other); season is the target term (summer_2027, fall_2027, coop, unspecified). level is not populated yet: answer level questions with 'not classified yet', never infer it from the title.
Company names live in silver_companies (join silver_roles.company_id = silver_companies.id). tier is the company's dream-tier bucket.

task_exposure holds the published automation_share per O*NET task (source column names the dataset). Labels: automation_share <= 0.33 is Human-led, >= 0.66 is Automatable, in between is AI-assisted. Only tasks present in task_exposure are measured; onet_tasks rows with no task_exposure row are 'not measured' and must be reported as such, never as human-led. Never say a job is safe or doomed.

archetypes is the open-vocabulary registry of role archetypes (name, ~50-word definition, aliases). There is no posting-to-archetype link table in this schema yet, so questions about postings per archetype cannot be answered; say so.

vt_courses, vt_majors and vt_checksheets are Virginia Tech's 2026-2027 catalog. Course codes look like 'CS 4824'; search title and description with ILIKE for topics. vt_checksheets maps a major to the course codes its checksheet requires.
